generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a single/multiple work orders and corresponding work done certificate issued by the Competent Authority (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year)

itemList.description: Collection (mannual) of coal samples from running coal Mill feeders of all running mills of Unit -2 to Unit - 8, transportation, preparation, Pulverization & disposal of used & unused coal sample to coal yard.

Collection (mannual) of Mill reject coal samples from running Units 2 to 8 from mills, transportation, preparation, Pulverization & disposal of used & unused Mill reject coal sample to Mill reject yard.
Collection, Preparation and Pulvarization of rake coal samples manually from Conveyor belts of CHP-1 and CHP-2, Stockyard and any other special coal samples
Collection and preparation of Wet / Dry Bottom Ash & Fly Ash of Unit-2 to 8
Collection, Preparation, Transportation and sieving of Pulverised coal samples of one running coal mill.
Assistance in testing of Feeder coal, Mill Reject Coal, Bottom and Fly Ash, PC sample, HFO & LDO oil samples, stockyard samples and any other special samples.
Assistance in collection and preparation of KECM(BCMPL) rake coal samples received at RTPS.
Assistance in collection and preparation of Biomass truck samples received at RTPS.

Transportation of coal samples collected from the wagons before tippling, feeder coal and Mill reject samples, Stock yard samples to coal sample preparation room and disposal of used and unused coal to coal stock yard and mill reject yard (3 hrs/day).
